verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes a public REST API reference under docs.sentry.io/api, including issue operations such as 'Bulk Mutate a List of Issues'. Its pricing lists 'API & third-party integrations', and webhooks are documented, so programmatic control of the product is clearly supported. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the common paths returned 404), in-depth evidence of API coverage, auth and rate limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving Sentry via the API.
